title: GCD: A Serial Queue Guards State
hints: A serial `DispatchQueue` runs one block at a time.
Wrap every read and write of `value` in `queue.sync`; mark the class `@unchecked Sendable`.
`func increment() { queue.sync { value += 1 } }` and `DispatchQueue.concurrentPerform(iterations: threads) { _ in … }`.
